rules.name: 科目发生额汇总
rules.desc: 按科目汇总借贷发生额与净额，用于快速看某类科目的规模。科目前缀留空=全部。
rules.sql:
SELECT acct_code AS "科目编码", max(acct_name) AS "科目名称", count(*) AS "分录数", sum(debit) AS "借方发生", sum(credit) AS "贷方发生", sum(coalesce(debit,0)-coalesce(credit,0)) AS "借贷净额"
FROM journal
WHERE acct_code LIKE '{{acct}}%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY abs(sum(coalesce(debit,0)-coalesce(credit,0))) DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

rules.name: 凭证借贷平衡检查
rules.desc: 按 期间+凭证类型+凭证号 聚合，列出借贷不等的凭证。容差 0.005 元以内视为平衡。
rules.sql:
SELECT coalesce(period,'') AS "期间", coalesce(vtype,'') AS "凭证类型", vno AS "凭证号", min(vdate) AS "日期", count(*) AS "分录数", sum(debit) AS "借方合计", sum(credit) AS "贷方合计", round(sum(coalesce(debit,0)-coalesce(credit,0)),2) AS "差额"
FROM journal
GROUP BY 1,2,3
HAVING abs(sum(coalesce(debit,0)-coalesce(credit,0))) > {{tol}}
ORDER BY abs(sum(coalesce(debit,0)-coalesce(credit,0))) DESC

rules.name: 月度发生额趋势
rules.desc: 按期间统计分录数、借贷发生额，用来判断数据是否完整、各月是否异常。
rules.sql:
SELECT coalesce(period, strftime(vdate,'%Y-%m')) AS "期间", count(*) AS "分录数", sum(debit) AS "借方发生", sum(credit) AS "贷方发生", round(sum(coalesce(debit,0)-coalesce(credit,0)),2) AS "借贷差"
FROM journal
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

rules.name: 大额分录
rules.desc: 筛出借方或贷方单笔达到阈值的分录。

rules.name: 三栏式明细账
rules.desc: 按科目输出逐笔发生额与累计余额（期初不在此表，累计余额为该科目自期初起滚动）。
rules.sql:
SELECT acct_code AS "科目编码", vdate AS "日期", vno AS "凭证号", summary AS "摘要", debit AS "借方", credit AS "贷方", sum(coalesce(debit,0)-coalesce(credit,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY acct_code ORDER BY vdate, src_row ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "累计余额"
FROM journal
WHERE acct_code LIKE '{{acct}}%'
ORDER BY acct_code, vdate, src_row
LIMIT {{limit}}

rules.name: 疑似重复分录
rules.desc: 同科目、同摘要、同金额出现多次，常见于重复入账或合并抵消。
rules.sql:
SELECT acct_code AS "科目编码", acct_name AS "科目名称", summary AS "摘要", debit AS "借方", credit AS "贷方", count(*) AS "次数", min(vdate) AS "首次", max(vdate) AS "末次", string_agg(DISTINCT vno, '、') AS "涉及凭证"
FROM journal
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
HAVING count(*) >= {{n}}
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, abs(coalesce(sum(debit),0)+coalesce(sum(credit),0)) DESC

rules.name: 摘要为空或含关键词
rules.desc: 找摘要缺失或含指定关键词（如 调整、冲销、结转、暂估）的分录。
rules.sql:
SELECT vdate AS "日期", vno AS "凭证号", summary AS "摘要", acct_code AS "科目编码", acct_name AS "科目名称", debit AS "借方", credit AS "贷方", src AS "来源"
FROM journal
WHERE summary IS NULL OR trim(summary) IN ('','-','/') OR summary LIKE '%{{kw}}%'
ORDER BY vdate
LIMIT {{limit}}

rules.name: 摘要 / 科目 关键词检索
rules.desc: 最常用的查账入口：摘要、科目名称、凭证号任意字段包含关键词。
rules.sql:
SELECT vdate AS "日期", vno AS "凭证号", summary AS "摘要", acct_code AS "科目编码", acct_name AS "科目名称", debit AS "借方", credit AS "贷方", src AS "来源", src_row AS "原始行号"
FROM journal
WHERE summary LIKE '%{{kw}}%' OR acct_name LIKE '%{{kw}}%' OR acct_code LIKE '%{{kw}}%' OR vno LIKE '%{{kw}}%'
ORDER BY vdate
LIMIT {{limit}}

rules.name: 凭证随机抽样
rules.desc: 按凭证级随机抽取 N 个凭证（不是分录），用于凭证抽查底稿。
rules.sql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT coalesce(period,'') AS period, coalesce(vtype,'') AS vtype, vno,
         min(vdate) AS vdate, count(*) AS n_lines,
         sum(coalesce(debit,0)) AS amt, any_value(summary) AS sample_summary
  FROM journal GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT * FROM v USING SAMPLE {{n}} ROWS

rules.name: 试算平衡总览
rules.desc: 期初、本期发生、期末的借贷合计与差额。差额应为 0。
rules.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS "科目数",
  sum(coalesce(open_debit,0)) AS "期初借方", sum(coalesce(open_credit,0)) AS "期初贷方",
  round(sum(coalesce(open_debit,0))-sum(coalesce(open_credit,0)),2) AS "期初差",
  sum(coalesce(cur_debit,0)) AS "本期借方", sum(coalesce(cur_credit,0)) AS "本期贷方",
  round(sum(coalesce(cur_debit,0))-sum(coalesce(cur_credit,0)),2) AS "本期差",
  sum(coalesce(end_debit,0)) AS "期末借方", sum(coalesce(end_credit,0)) AS "期末贷方",
  round(sum(coalesce(end_debit,0))-sum(coalesce(end_credit,0)),2) AS "期末差"
FROM tb

rules.name: 期初＋发生＝期末 勾稽
rules.desc: 逐科目核对：期初余额 + 本期借 − 本期贷 − 期末余额 应为 0。
rules.sql:
SELECT acct_code AS "科目编码", acct_name AS "科目名称", open_bal AS "期初净额", cur_debit AS "本期借方", cur_credit AS "本期贷方", end_bal AS "期末净额",
  round(coalesce(open_bal,0)+coalesce(cur_debit,0)-coalesce(cur_credit,0)-coalesce(end_bal,0),2) AS "差异"
FROM tb
WHERE abs(coalesce(open_bal,0)+coalesce(cur_debit,0)-coalesce(cur_credit,0)-coalesce(end_bal,0)) > {{tol}}
ORDER BY abs(coalesce(open_bal,0)+coalesce(cur_debit,0)-coalesce(cur_credit,0)-coalesce(end_bal,0)) DESC

rules.name: 期末余额排名
rules.desc: 按期末净额绝对值排序，快速定位重要科目。
rules.sql:
SELECT acct_code AS "科目编码", acct_name AS "科目名称", open_bal AS "期初净额", cur_debit AS "本期借方", cur_credit AS "本期贷方", end_bal AS "期末净额"
FROM tb
ORDER BY abs(coalesce(end_bal,0)) DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

rules.name: 余额表 vs 序时账 发生额比对
rules.desc: 按科目前 N 位汇总，比较科目余额表本期发生额与序时账借贷合计，找差异科目。
rules.sql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT substr(acct_code,1,{{len}}) AS code, sum(coalesce(cur_debit,0)) AS d, sum(coalesce(cur_credit,0)) AS c
  FROM tb GROUP BY 1
), b AS (
  SELECT substr(acct_code,1,{{len}}) AS code, sum(coalesce(debit,0)) AS d, sum(coalesce(credit,0)) AS c
  FROM journal GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(a.code,b.code) AS "科目", a.d AS "余额表借方", b.d AS "序时账借方", round(coalesce(a.d,0)-coalesce(b.d,0),2) AS "借方差异",
       a.c AS "余额表贷方", b.c AS "序时账贷方", round(coalesce(a.c,0)-coalesce(b.c,0),2) AS "贷方差异"
FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.code = b.code
WHERE abs(coalesce(a.d,0)-coalesce(b.d,0)) > {{tol}} OR abs(coalesce(a.c,0)-coalesce(b.c,0)) > {{tol}}
ORDER BY abs(coalesce(a.d,0)-coalesce(b.d,0)) + abs(coalesce(a.c,0)-coalesce(b.c,0)) DESC

rules.name: 外币科目：原币 vs 本币
rules.desc: 列出有外币金额的科目，并算出隐含汇率（本币 ÷ 原币），用于核对折算汇率是否异常。需要余额表映射了外币列（_fx）。
rules.sql:
SELECT acct_code AS "科目编码", acct_name AS "科目名称", currency AS "币种",
  end_bal_fx AS "期末原币", end_bal AS "期末本币",
  round(coalesce(end_bal,0) / nullif(end_bal_fx,0), 4) AS "期末隐含汇率",
  cur_debit_fx AS "本期原币借方", cur_debit AS "本期本币借方",
  round(coalesce(cur_debit,0) / nullif(cur_debit_fx,0), 4) AS "本期隐含汇率",
  cur_credit_fx AS "本期原币贷方", cur_credit AS "本期本币贷方"
FROM tb
WHERE coalesce(end_bal_fx,0) <> 0 OR coalesce(cur_debit_fx,0) <> 0 OR coalesce(cur_credit_fx,0) <> 0
ORDER BY abs(coalesce(end_bal,0)) DESC
